stated: Free up local officers’ time to focus on their communities by: Creating a new Online Crime Agency to effectively tackle illegal content and activity online, such as personal fraud, revenge porn and threats and incitement to violence on social media.

source.quote: Free up local officers’ time to focus on their communities by: Creating a new Online Crime Agency to effectively tackle illegal content and activity online, such as personal fraud, revenge porn and threats and incitement to violence on social media.

bearing_set.reason: Creating a dedicated agency to tackle online fraud, revenge porn, and incitement to violence directly addresses crime rates, victim justice, and law-enforcement capacity — all core O5 indicators.

A new state agency with powers to monitor, investigate, and act on online content (including 'illegal content,' threats, and incitement on social media) constitutes new coercive/surveillance infrastructure that bears concretely on freedom of expression and online privacy, even when targeting already-illegal material.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: the designed-for crime-reduction effect (O5) and the liberty-side cost of new online enforcement powers (O10) — a classic safety/liberty tradeoff. Local officer reallocation is an efficiency mechanism, not a separate outcome.
